description: Videos shown on built-in public pages, set in code. Each entry points at self-hosted files in frontend/public/media/videos/ (MP4 + WebM + poster image + WebVTT captions) and is rendered by the web app's SiteVideo player, the server-rendered HTML, a VideoObject JSON-LD node and the video sitemap. The backend holds an identical copy (backend/src/OptimizeAll.Api/Modules/Website/SiteSeo/site-videos.json); the unit test SiteVideoCatalogTests fails when the two differ. CMS pages use the Video block instead. Example entry: { "path": "/", "title": "How Optimize All works", "description": "A 90-second tour of our process.", "mp4Url": "/media/videos/how-we-work.mp4", "webmUrl": "/media/videos/how-we-work.webm", "posterUrl": "/media/videos/how-we-work.jpg", "captionsUrl": "/media/videos/how-we-work.en.vtt", "captionsLanguage": "en", "durationSeconds": 90, "uploadDate": "2026-09-24", "transcript": null }
